---
title: "Recipe 7 — Pre-seed the kernel maps from the operator bundle"
---

| Tool | Section | Level | Time | Layer | Tags |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`test/route-e2e`](https://github.com/trishula-dev/trishula/tree/main/test/route-e2e), Linux VM, root, BTF | Kernel · operator | hard | 10 min | kernel · lpm | bundle, route class, verifier |

### Problem

You want the bundle's kernel leg loaded before traffic. You want the route-class
LPM rows from the compiled policy.

### Solution

1. Run the route E2E (root, Linux, BTF present). `ROUTE_E2E_REQUIRED=1` turns
every environment skip into a failure:

```bash
sudo env PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" ROUTE_E2E_REQUIRED=1 \
  go test -tags route_e2e -count=1 -v ./test/route-e2e/
```

2. Read the load proof. The suite compiles the full pathway and loads it under
the kernel verifier:

```text
=== RUN   TestRouteClassLoadProofE2E
--- PASS: TestRouteClassLoadProofE2E (<seconds>s)
--- PASS: TestBundleShapeLoadGate (<seconds>s)
--- PASS: TestBundleShapeGateNegatives (<seconds>s)
PASS
```

### Discussion

The pathway runs end to end. `WAFPolicy` compiles to a bundle. The bundle instantiates one verifier-accepted route-mark program with one LPM map. The map carries the compiled route prefixes as the pre-seeded rows. No
netns and no traffic attach ride this proof: the gate is the verifier load plus
the read-back. The census stamps each policy field kernel or slow path; the
census record defines the boundary.

The bundle shapes walk as a contract. A bundle that loses its kernel leg fails before the verifier sees it.
